name: Ultimate Oscillator
description: This keyword returns the value of the Ultimate Oscillator of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the value of the Ultimate Oscillator of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632224953.png)

You can fetch the value of the  Ultimate Oscillator  on any candle of an instrument, like in the above example, you can fetch the  Ultimate Oscillator  of previous (-1) 5 min candle of Nifty Bank futures.
